items.title: The best game I’ve played
items.summary: I’m always trying to find different and new, fun gacha roleplay games and this by far is my favorite one. I’m surprised this game isn’t more popular. I just seen an add on YouTube for a song from the game and I thought I might as well look it up and download it. Now I haven’t stopped playing the game. I 100% recommend someone playing this if they like CRK (Cookie Run Kingdom) or other games similar to the looks of it. :)
items.author: Isabella5310
